page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 40 physical cores and 40 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz with 1 thread per core. The processor features 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 35 MB L3 cache, alongside support for AVX, AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AES instructions. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource density of 4.8 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across multiple workloads. In CPU-focused tests, the instance achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07, while the Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores reached 1289.0 and 12045.0 respectively. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2133.36 GB/sec, dropping to 108.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, and a write bandwidth of 48.09 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, the server processed 34.78 million Redis SET operations per second and demonstrated a static web serving throughput of 25.35 GB/sec. Large language model inference speeds for a small 135M model reached 1841.39 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 76.66 tokens/sec for text generation.

The lack of bundled local storage requires reliance on external network-attached storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs for I/O-heavy operations. However, the dedicated core allocation ensures consistent CPU performance without resource contention. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the balanced 1:4.8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio provides a stable resource density suitable for enterprise applications without the premium cost of memory-optimized hardware. This configuration is appropriate for workloads such as database operations, web serving, software compilation, and moderate-scale text and image processing.
